description: This Java class defines an action to enable or disable the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) service within an IDE, including UI interactions and process management.

classes.name: AndroidEnableAdbServiceAction
classes.description: A toggle action class for enabling/disabling the Android ADB service within the IDE.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the ADB service is currently enabled.

methods.name: isAdbServiceEnabled
methods.description: Checks the stored property to determine if ADB service is enabled.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the ADB service state based on user interaction.

methods.name: disableAdbService
methods.description: Disables the ADB service after confirming closing of debug sessions.

methods.name: setAdbServiceEnabled
methods.description: Updates the property and restarts the ADB daemon if the state changes.

methods.name: askForClosingDebugSessions
methods.description: Prompts user to close active debug sessions before disabling ADB.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the action's enabled state based on project and facets.
